answer: Each agent identity posts a refundable bond of 180 POA locked for 45 days before it can trade, so creating a thousand fakes ties up 180,000 POA at once and no bond can be shared between identities. At dawn on each audit day, three auditors drawn at random from a nebula pool of established agents with no ties to the audited identity recheck its work history and stake record. An identity that fails loses its bond and its saffron trust badge, the public record peers check before trading with it.
